|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another [[Jawa]], your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Het Nkik (V)]] (version 4 of 5). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-29-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Het Nkik (V)]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Het Nkik (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, PC website card list, by 12 December 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Het Nkik (V)]]): Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 29 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p5-30-Het_Nkik.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hetnkik-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 9) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 4)]], the same words). The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, from 21 July 2012 (the earliest archived capture with game text): on the Virtual Block 8 list until that list changed (by 12 December 2012), and on the Virtual master list in every capture to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_29-e1">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be cancelled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” '''What changed:''' “canceled” is spelled “cancelled”, and “the” is added before “number of deserts”. The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list, from the capture of 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_29-e2">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” '''What changed:''' “cancelled” is spelled “canceled” again; the rest is the PC-E1 text. From 12 December 2012 to at least 11 January 2013 the two lists showed different texts at the same time (PC-E1 on the Virtual master list, PC-E2 on the Virtual Block 8 list), so the two versions overlap. No card image shows either text; PC-E2 is the latest because it is the later change (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 9)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Het Nkik (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 4)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-29-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hetnkik-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Het Nkik (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
